method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49316), Residential Tenancies Act 1987 with editorial changes as at 29 Apr 2026; compilation table to the Statutes (Repeals and Minor Amendments) Act 2025 s 35 (26 Sep 2025); Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 2024 Pt 2 in force (16 May 2024, 29 Jul 2024, 28 Mar 2026). roles: I am the tenant: I rent the home
I am the lessor, or the property manager acting for the lessor

situation_parameters.name: the lessor has given a notice of termination
questions: What does the notice of termination I was given do
By when may I ask a court to extend a no-grounds notice
How much extra time may a court give me on a no-grounds notice
What does my notice of termination do
By when may the tenant ask a court to extend my no-grounds notice
How much extra time may a court give the tenant on my no-grounds notice

situation_parameters.name: the tenant has given a notice of termination
questions: Is the tenant's notice ending the tenancy valid

situation_parameters.name: the tenancy is for a fixed term
questions: What is the last day to give notice ending my fixed term on its expiry day
What happens to my tenancy when the fixed term expires
If my lessor and I both give notice ending the fixed term, which possession day counts
What is the last day I can give notice ending the fixed term on its expiry day
What happens to the tenancy I grant when the fixed term expires
If the tenant and I both give notice ending the fixed term, which possession day counts

situation_parameters.name: the tenancy has ended
questions: By when must my lessor give me the final condition report
By when must I give the tenant the final condition report

situation_parameters.name: the tenant has been given the condition report
questions: By when must I give back my marked copy of the condition report
Am I taken to have accepted the condition report
Is the tenant taken to have accepted my condition report

situation_parameters.name: a rent increase notice has been given or is proposed
questions: Does the rent increase I was given take effect
Does the rent increase I give take effect

situation_parameters.name: a bond increase has been proposed
questions: May my lessor increase my bond as proposed
May I increase the bond as I propose

situation_parameters.name: a bond release application has been made
questions: What will happen to my bond release application
What will happen to the bond release application I am party to
